faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Elrena says, "The events of the cataclysm taint the swamp even to this day." "When the great deluge of Zoth Uluus poured crashing onto this forest, Zoth's foul tendrils sank into the loamy soils. Those beings who were not drowned became infused with his blight." "The treants , once great protectors of this place, now walk with black, waterlogged roots, angry and mindless. They have become blight striders. There is naught to do but journey to the Tree of Corruption and destroy them." [ edit ] Objectives Travel to the Tree of Corruption to the northeast and slay the blight striders there. Return to Elrena Faermil at the Recondite Threshold . Blight Striders Slain at the Tree of Corruption (7) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 6s A choice of: Eargem of Conduction Fortifying Eargem of Spirit Eargem of Reflection Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Blight_Striders " Category : Thestra 26-30 Quests
